registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Firmware control register. Bit 0 enables the controller. Bits 2:1 select the model. Bit 3 is a write-one fault-clear pulse. All other bits are reserved and read as 0.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Controller enable. When 0, the controller inhibits actuator command validity and does not emit a substitute command.

fields.name: MODEL_SELECT
fields.description: Selects the physics surrogate/model variant used by the controller core.

fields.name: FAULT_CLEAR
fields.description: Write-one pulse request to clear the latched fault, accepted only when the invalid condition is no longer present.

registers.name: SPEED_BOUNDS
registers.description: Operating speed band in meters per second. The controller is intended for 20-55 m/s operation and may be configured within this register.

fields.name: MIN_SPEED_MPS
fields.description: Lower supported operating speed bound in m/s.

fields.name: MAX_SPEED_MPS
fields.description: Upper supported operating speed bound in m/s.

registers.name: CMD_BOUNDS
registers.description: Bounded actuator command limits. The controller clamps any valid command to this range before asserting actuator_cmd_valid.

registers.name: TIMING
registers.description: Controller timing limits in cycles for response timeout and sensor stale-data detection.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Maximum cycles allowed before response timeout is declared.

fields.name: STALE_LIMIT_CYCLES
fields.description: Maximum cycles allowed before stale-data handling is declared.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live controller status for firmware observation.

fields.name: FAULT_LATCHED
fields.description: Latched fault indication for software handling.

fields.name: SAFETY_INHIBIT
fields.description: Indicates that actuator command validity is currently inhibited.

fields.name: LAST_CMD_VALID
fields.description: Indicates whether the last accepted actuator command was valid.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_ACTIVE
fields.description: Indicates that timeout handling is active.

fields.name: LAST_CMD_DATA
fields.description: Most recently accepted bounded actuator command.

registers.name: LAST_SPEED
registers.description: Most recent observed vehicle speed sample associated with controller state.

fields.name: LAST_SPEED_MPS
fields.description: Most recent observed vehicle speed in m/s.

init_sequence: Write CTRL.ENABLE=0 and program SPEED_BOUNDS, CMD_BOUNDS, and TIMING to desired values.
Write CTRL.MODEL_SELECT to choose the surrogate variant.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS to check FAULT_LATCHED, SAFETY_INHIBIT, LAST_CMD_VALID, TIMEOUT_ACTIVE, and LAST_CMD_DATA.
Read LAST_SPEED to observe the most recent speed sample.
If FAULT_LATCHED is set, clear the fault only after the invalid condition is removed by writing CTRL.FAULT_CLEAR=1.

consistency_notes: The register map is compatible with the declared MMIO CSR interface and hierarchical top-level contract.
No additional hierarchy, ports, or bus protocol are invented.
All firmware-visible registers correspond to declared control and status semantics in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
Bulk history storage remains in the technology-neutral memory wrapper and is not flattened into registers.
No fallback command or substitute control behavior is introduced.
